name: Exp_CronexCCI
summary: This EA trades based on the CronexCCI custom indicator, which applies double smoothing to CCI values to generate trend and signal lines. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position opening and closing toggles.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CronexCCI自定义指标进行交易，该指标对CCI值进行双重平滑处理生成趋势线和信号线。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，支持可配置的开仓和平仓开关。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于CronexCCI指标的趋势线与信号线交叉系统。CronexCCI指标首先计算CCI值，然后分别用快速周期和慢速周期的平滑算法生成两条线——主线和信号线。入场条件为：当主线上穿信号线时产生买入信号，下穿时产生卖出信号，交叉判断使用相邻两根K线的值进行比较。出场条件有两种：一是反向交叉信号触发平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose），二是固定的止损和止盈（StopLoss_和TakeProfit_参数）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持基于自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数五种模式。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的标准化函数进行下单，带有滑点控制（Deviation_）。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根K线的信号来避免重绘问题，同时使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a crossover system between the trend line and signal line of the CronexCCI indicator. CronexCCI first computes CCI values, then applies fast-period and slow-period smoothing algorithms to generate two lines—the main line and the signal line. Entry conditions are: a buy signal occurs when the main line crosses above the signal line, and a sell signal on the opposite crossover, using adjacent bar values for crossover detection. Exit conditions come in two forms: reverse crossover signals trigger position closing (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose), and fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels are applied via StopLoss_ and TakeProfit_ parameters. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which represents the risk fraction, supporting five margin modes including free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses standardized functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh for order placement with slippage control (Deviation_). The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1 to reference the previous completed bar, avoiding repainting issues, while the IsNewBar mechanism ensures signal computation happens only once per bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损后自由保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots/balance/free margin etc.)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（反向信号平多仓）

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（反向信号平空仓）

parameters.name: CCIPrice
parameters.description: CCI计算使用的数据价格类型

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 平滑算法相位参数，JJMA范围为-100到+100

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号引用的K线索引，1表示前一根已完成的K线

pros: 使用双平滑CCI交叉系统，相比原始CCI减少了假信号和噪音干扰
提供完整的开仓/平仓开关控制，灵活性高，可以单独禁用买入或卖出方向
采用IsNewBar机制限制每个K线只计算一次信号，避免Tick级别的重复计算和过度交易
支持多种平滑算法和仓位管理模式，适应不同市场环境和交易偏好
使用SignalBar=1引用已完成的K线数据，避免了指标重绘问题
pros_en: Dual-smoothed CCI crossover system reduces false signals and noise compared to raw CCI
Complete open/close toggle controls provide high flexibility, allowing independent disabling of buy or sell directions
IsNewBar mechanism limits signal computation to once per bar, avoiding tick-level redundant calculations and overtrading
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms and position sizing modes, adaptable to different market environments and trading preferences
Uses SignalBar=1 referencing completed bar data, avoiding indicator repainting issues
cons: 没有扩展点差过滤机制，在高波动时段点差扩大时可能导致不必要的滑点损失
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值偏大，对大多数货币对而言可能不够精细
缺少移动止损或追踪止损功能，盈利头寸可能在大幅回撤后才由反向信号平仓
没有检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能在趋势延续中重复开仓
依赖外部自定义指标CronexCCI和库文件，增加了部署复杂性和兼容性风险
cons_en: No spread filter mechanism, which can lead to unnecessary slippage losses during high-volatility sessions with widened spreads
Default StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are quite large and may lack precision for most currency pairs
No trailing stop functionality, so profitable positions may suffer significant drawdowns before being closed by a reverse signal
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to repeated entries during trending markets
Depends on external custom indicator CronexCCI and library files, increasing deployment complexity and compatibility risks
improvements: 增加点差过滤器，在点差超过阈值时暂停开仓，避免不利成交价格
添加追踪止损功能，在头寸盈利后锁定部分利润，降低回撤风险
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致过度集中风险
考虑加入交易时段过滤，避免在低流动性或高波动新闻时段交易
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause new entries when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable fill prices
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in partial profits after positions move in favor, reducing drawdown risk
Add position existence checks to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction, avoiding over-concentration risk
Consider adding trading session filters to avoid trading during low-liquidity or high-volatility news periods

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，在新闻事件或低流动性时段点差扩大时可能以不利价格成交
没有持仓检查，可能在同方向连续开仓导致仓位过度集中
固定止损止盈值较大（1000/2000点），在短周期使用时风险敞口过高
依赖外部自定义指标和库文件，若文件缺失或版本不匹配可能导致初始化失败
risk_points_en: No spread filter, may fill at unfavorable prices when spreads widen during news events or low-liquidity sessions
No position check, may open consecutive positions in the same direction leading to over-concentration
Fixed SL/TP values are large (1000/2000 points), creating excessive risk exposure when used on shorter timeframes
Depends on external custom indicator and library files; missing or version-mismatched files can cause initialization failure
